description: Moves the pre-redesign catch_ui dock's callers (its utility, primary, pageAction and primaryContent recipes) from CatchDock to CatchLegacyDock, and the moved file's path, under the same trees as the top bar rename, now that CatchDock takes the system's placements. One-shot: --check, --dry-run and the rename run by hand on branches cut before the first caller of the system dock; CI runs only its tests.
reason: The redesign P2.1 rename landed on main: the pre-redesign components live on as CatchLegacy*, and the system components now own the old names, so this codemod's --check reports correct callers and running it would break them. design:library-shims ratchets the legacy residue. Its callers moved to CatchLegacyDock (catch_legacy_dock.dart).
